title: First drumming job with Young Morgan and Son Leger
summary: Howard fills in at a party, is hired by Young Morgan, buys a $62.50 drum set and plays with Son Leger.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons
